what_happened: The person running Athena looked at the plan and records at the 23:42 UTC update. The steward's fix that lets fresh Athena fixes jump the stale queue was approved at 19:16 UTC. It sits at about place 199 of 202, behind the October backlog, so it waits behind the problem it fixes. A second steward item, which requires fix requests to show their cause in the records, has no decision recorded and no job. No job failed. The person running Athena reported it and did not reorder the queue by hand.
cause: Queue order is set by age and tier, not by the value of the item. Nothing puts a fix to the queue's own ordering ahead of the backlog it addresses. Approved steward items are also not tracked from approval to decision to job, so one can be approved and never become a job. The ordering fix and the cause-check item are in the same position as the fixes they were meant to rescue.
prevention: Two changes would prevent the class. First, approved fixes for known Athena failure classes, and above all fixes to the queue's own ordering, are dispatched ahead of ordinary backlog items by a rule in the planner. Stale or duplicate items are retired or revalidated so they cannot block those fixes. Second, a check lists approved steward items that have no decision or job after a set time, and the plan or status page shows them.
proposed_request: Make the queue plan place approved Athena fixes for recorded failure classes ahead of ordinary backlog items, with the queue-ordering fix itself first. Outcome: after the change, the steward fix that lets fresh Athena fixes jump the stale queue, and the cause-check item (fix requests must show their cause in the records), run in the next dispatches instead of waiting behind the October backlog. Also add a check that flags any approved steward item with no decision or job recorded within 24 hours, and show it in `athena plan` output. Acceptance: (1) a plan built from a queue with 200 older normal items puts an approved fix item in the first positions; (2) an approved steward item with no decision or job is listed as unowned by the check; (3) the CHANGELOG.md entry is written.
